text: I have been on hold twice now and nobody has rung me back, so I'm trying this instead. It's my grandson Alfie, he's 4, staying with me while his mum's on nights. He's been off colour since yesterday morning, a bit quiet, not interested in his tea, which I put down to him just being tired. But I went in to get him up for a drink about an hour ago and I honestly couldn't get him to come round properly. His eyes opened for a second and then he just sort of flopped back. He didn't grumble at me or push me away like he normally would, he usually hates being woken. I've tried again since, saying his name and sitting him up, and it's the same, he's heavy and floppy and doesn't really seem to know I'm there. I might be making a fuss, I don't know, he could just be in a very deep sleep. But it's not like him at all and I've had four of my own so I'd like to think I know the difference. I'd appreciate someone actually getting back to me this time.
